summary: Store-wide `global_settings`: layout, rhythm, palettes, typography scale, product card, UX behaviour. Set it first.
rules: `kit.py theme set` replaces all of `global_settings`: always apply a preset over the pulled object (`design.py presets apply theme <preset> --work work.json`), never write a partial object.
Palettes merge by `id`. A section may reference only a palette id that exists in `appearance.colors.palettes`.
Never write `typography.fontFamily`: a font carries uploaded file references per weight that cannot be looked up here. Change the font in the cabinet theme editor.
Do not touch payment, age-gate or out-of-stock legal toggles (`features.enableYandexSplit`, `features.enableYandexDiscount`, `features.enableAgeGate`, `outOfStockProducts`).
`brandPrimary` comes from the brand or the merchant.

appearance.colors.brandPrimary: <fill: brand colour — keep the store's value>

presets.name: layout-editorial
presets.use: Fashion, lifestyle, objects: edge-to-edge sections, sharp corners, generous rhythm.
presets.evidence: 18 stores in the sharp + full-width + 3:4 cluster

presets.name: layout-boxed-catalog
presets.use: Wide assortments and packshots: boxed at 1400, normal rounding.

presets.name: layout-soft-friendly
presets.use: Kids, family, health, food: soft rounding and even gutters.

presets.name: layout-narrow-editorial
presets.use: A narrow content column for brand storytelling with a small assortment and big type (about 1100 px of content). Pair it with `typography-display-left`.

presets.name: palettes-three-roles
presets.use: A light alternate and a dark closing palette next to the base one, reusing the store's own light and dark palettes where it has them. The default for a new store.
presets.evidence: 3 palettes is the most common count (20 of 43 stores)
fill: `presets apply` reuses a light and a dark palette the store already has (text at 4.5:1 or more on a clearly light or dark background): it keeps their ids and colours, gives them the role names and adds only the role that is missing. Point sections at the ids the report names.

Palettes no section uses are noise (41 of 95 extra palettes in the reference sample are never used): `design.py theme palettes --work work.json` counts the references (a custom section's palette fields too, such as a divider's `backdropPalette`), `--prune --out gs.json` drops the unused ones.

presets.name: palette-warm-base
presets.use: Premium, craft, food, home: tint the base palette off-white with a warm dark text.
presets.evidence: 8 stores tint the base background, about 10 tint the text

presets.name: typography-centred-3xl
presets.use: The most common heading scale: centred 3xl.

presets.name: typography-centred-2xl
presets.use: Text-led stores (cosmetics and health, services, a blog or help centre): centred 2xl, so section titles stop competing with the page heading and the content.

presets.name: typography-left-3xl
presets.use: Catalogs and magazine layouts: left-aligned 3xl headings.

presets.name: typography-display-left
presets.use: Editorial and streetwear with a condensed or display face: left 5xl.

presets.name: card-lifestyle
presets.use: Apparel and lifestyle on models or in scenes: 3:4 photos, no buttons, title before price.
presets.evidence: 3:4 photos in 34 stores; title first in 30

presets.name: card-packshot
presets.use: Cut-outs, cosmetics, electronics, gifts: 1:1 photos on the base colour, title before price, card buttons on every shelf and listing.
presets.evidence: 1:1 photos in 9 stores, most of them with card buttons; title before price in 30 of 43 stores

presets.name: card-minimal-mono
presets.use: Editorial or mono-font stores: small price, dash carousel, discount colours inherit the text colour.

presets.name: behaviour-defaults
presets.use: UX defaults of the reference stores: cart in a side view, favourites on, compact carousel controls, review stars on cards.
presets.evidence: split view in 33 stores, favourites in 41
fill: `delivery.enableProgress`: on by default, it prints «До бесплатной доставки: N ₽» under the buy button and in the cart whenever the backend reports a threshold. Keep it only with a free-delivery threshold the merchant confirmed; otherwise write `false` (`presets apply` lists it in `open`).

presets.name: touch-gutters
presets.use: Phone side insets of 16 px for every section: the usual value. Sections that must bleed set their own `hPaddingMobile: "0"`.
